newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore 6-year high-tech export trend up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Singapore 6-year high-tech export trend up sharply.

text.p: Singapore's domestic exports of high-tech products rose by about 16 percent between 1990-1996 to reach Singapore $56.2 billion in 1996, the government's Trade Development Board (TDB) said on Tuesday.
The share of high-tech goods as a percentage of non-oil domestic exports had risen to 65 percent last year from 52 percent in 1990, the TDB said in a statement.
"This reflects the success of Singapore's efforts to restructure and upgrade its economy to one based on high-tech and high value-added industries," the TDB said.

It said exports should continue expanding because of increased spending for research and development while the recently concluded Information Technology Agreement was likely to be another boost for exports in this area.
